summary: Multi-category (rubros) feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed - /api/categories/counts returns per-key counts, POST with 3 categories creates a workshop that appears in each category filter and NOT in unrelated ones, PUT updates propagate to filters, search+category combined works, seeded workshops still queryable, migration backfilled categories[]. Frontend: admin login OK, dashboard shows chips 'Todas · 68', 'Lavado de Vehículos · 57' etc., admin-cat-lavado filter yields 57 rows, admin-cat-all resets, workshop rows show rubro badges, admin-add form supports multi-select (chips toggle independently), 3 chips can be active simultaneously, saving with 0 rubros shows validation error 'Completa los campos obligatorios (*) y elige al menos un rubro', creating with 2 rubros persists both, editing pre-checks previously-selected rubros. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _normalize_categories: uses side-effect (seen.add()) inside list comprehension - functional but non-idiomatic. Minor style nit.
GET /categories/counts issues N sequential count_documents queries (N=9). Could be a single aggregation. Fine at current scale (68 workshops).
seed_data_creation: Test workshops created (TEST_MultiRubro, TEST_UI_MultiRubro) were deleted via fixture teardown and explicit cleanup after UI test. Verified no TEST_ prefixed records remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-category feature is fully working. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_multi_category.py covers CRUD + filtering. Frontend testIDs used: admin-cat-{key}, admin-cat-all, admin-add, f-cat-{key}, form-save, form-error, admin-row-{id}, admin-edit-{id}, admin-search. Login submit button label is 'Iniciar sesión' (not 'Ingresar').
